analysis.aggregate: For each pre-registered metric and ratio, report all three block values plus median and min-max; do not compute a p-value or population interval.
analysis.block_comparison: Within each block compare Elastic/Fixed and Free/Fixed using wall_time_s, successful_traces_per_s, observed_cpu_core_seconds, and observed_memory_gib_seconds. Compare Elastic/Fixed additionally on total_reserved_cpu_core_seconds and total_reserved_memory_gb_seconds.
analysis.contention_diagnostics: Report admission timeout counts, CPU and memory resize rejection counts, applied CPU grow and shrink counts by reason, and host oom_kill and swap deltas separately from performance outcomes.
analysis.metric_source: Use scripts/plot_ear_replay.py so all three arms share the same fail-closed provenance, replay-configuration, and sampler-coverage gates.
analysis.normalized_match_pattern: Compare normalized_output_match after keying and sorting tool actions by source_agent_id and source_action_id; concurrent JSONL write order is not semantic.
analysis.paired_task_diagnostic: Report all 32 task elapsed_s values by arm and the within-block Elastic/Fixed and Free/Fixed task ratios as an explicitly development-only diagnostic; do not summarize heterogeneous task ratios as a population estimate.

claim_scope: Outcome-informed development mechanism study on one 28-vCPU host and the same 32 TB-dev100 traces. The schedule balances ordinal arm position but not transitions or carryover. It supports no Terminal-Bench population, cross-host, or broad causal claim.

execution.command_expansion: For each run, take the selected arm_command_templates argv array and replace the single {output_dir} element with the run output_dir string; do not insert, remove, split, or join any other argv element.
execution.retry_policy: No automatic retry. Stop on any scheduled replay command or required gate failure, preserve evidence, and remove only exact residual objects created by the failed arm.
execution.stop_condition: Stop immediately if a scheduled replay command exits nonzero or any required after-arm or after-block gate fails.

excluded_before_selection.git-workflow-hack: Previously established deterministic per-call working-directory replay mismatch in analysis/development/ear-c4-tb8-20260730/design.json before this study.
excluded_before_selection.interactive-maze-game: Its frozen docker-compose.yaml requires a companion maze service, while single-image replay starts only the client container.
excluded_before_selection.security-vulhub-minio: Its frozen docker-compose.yaml requires three companion MinIO services, while single-image replay starts only the client container.
excluded_before_selection.simple-web-scraper: Its frozen docker-compose.yaml requires a companion mock web server, while single-image replay starts only the client container.

selection.method: Take the first 32 eligible task IDs from the frozen seed-42 TB-dev100 order after removing the pre-existing parity-invalid task and tasks whose frozen compose topology requires companion services unavailable to single-image replay; do not replace tasks based on scale-run performance.
selection.split_copy_normalization: The pinned copy adds one trailing newline; parsed JSON content is unchanged from the source split.

preflight_gates: The formal output root and smoke output root do not exist.
The ASB code commit, EAR commit, policy SHA256, manifest SHA256, smoke manifest SHA256, tasks SHA256, and pinned TB-dev100 split SHA256 match this design.
The remote host signature has 28 online CPUs, at least 75 GiB total memory, cgroup v2, working unprivileged Docker access, and no other trace_collect.cli simulate process.
All 32 source trace paths exist as regular files and match the source_trace_sha256 map.
All 32 mutable Docker image tags resolve to the exact image_ids map.

Each Fixed lease requests the policy ceiling of 2 CPU and 2.5 GiB, so c16 requests up to 32 CPU and 40 GiB against a 24 CPU and 60 GiB pool and excess starts wait in the existing admission queue for up to 300 seconds; Elastic starts at 16 CPU and 32 GiB with 8 CPU and 28 GiB growth headroom. This CPU admission difference is intentional.
The host /proc/vmstat oom_kill counter and swap usage are recorded before every scheduled replay.

smoke.claim_status: Plumbing only; exclude from every performance table and claim.

after_all_blocks: Report all three block values plus median and min-max exactly as pre-registered; do not combine the local c4 study, smoke, or any c24 result.
Report treatment and contention diagnostics separately from performance outcomes.
after_each_arm_before_next_arm: The scheduled command exits zero and throughput reports attempted=completed=32, failed=0, action_count=966, llm_call_count=499, and tool_exec_count=467.
The arm has 467/467 replay tool outcomes matched and zero mismatches.
The arm has exactly one monitored container per completed trace, at least two samples and positive sample-window duration per container, no sampler errors or drops, and stop_complete=true.

Fixed and Elastic have valid matching EAR lifecycle provenance, zero OOM kills, zero admission timeout rejects, zero CPU or memory resize rejections, no runtime errors, and the locked mode and policy SHA.
Free has no EAR runtime metadata, controller_summary.json, or lease_events.jsonl.
The host oom_kill counter does not increase during the arm; swap usage and system load deltas are reported.
No task container ID or sweep fixed image name recorded by this arm remains.
after_each_block_before_next_block: Expand and run plot_command_template with the block's three exact arm directories; its role, source-entry, replay-config, policy-provenance, and sampler gates pass.
The three throughput summaries have identical source trace entries, 966 actions, 499 LLM calls, and 467 tool executions.
The three arms have 467/467 matched outcomes, zero mismatches, and the same identity-keyed normalized-output match pattern.
The block output contains ear_timeline.png, ear_fixed_elastic_free.png, and ear_comparison.json.
